The presence of enhancement suggests vascularity or breakdown of the blood-brain barrier. Grade 3 (Anaplastic Astrocytoma) is less likely given the extent of invasion and mass effect described. Grade 2 (Diffuse Astrocytoma) is highly unlikely given these aggressive features.
